subject: StablecoinVaultSimulator

artifactManifest.notes: bytecodeHash is keccak256 of the live runtime bytecode with (a) the trailing 43-byte solc CBOR metadata region and (b) all 8 immutable-variable byte ranges (solc deployedBytecode.immutableReferences: `token`, plus OpenZeppelin EIP712's _cachedDomainSeparator/_cachedChainId/_cachedThis/_hashedName/_hashedVersion/_name/_version) zeroed out — executableBytecodeMatch covers this same normalized region. The 8 immutable values themselves are NOT included in bytecodeHash; instead each was independently re-derived from public inputs only (constructor args below, this contract's own deployed address, chain ID 11155111, and the EIP-712 domain name/version literals "WalletWallStablecoinVault"/"1" read from source) and confirmed to match the corresponding live on-chain slot exactly, byte for byte. constructorArgs are [token, verifier] in StablecoinVaultSimulator(address _token, address _pqVerifier) order; note only `token` is a Solidity `immutable` — the verifier address is regular contract storage, not baked into runtime bytecode. Verified from a clean `npm ci` + `npx hardhat compile` in a worktree pinned to the deployment commit (Hardhat 2 / solc 0.8.24+commit.e11b9ed9, optimizer runs=200, evmVersion=cancun) against the live Sepolia runtime read via eth_getCode; independently cross-checked with a second solc build variant (solc-js/WASM) to rule out a compiler-binary cause for the metadata divergence.

disclosures: TESTNET ONLY — Ethereum Sepolia. Research prototype. Not audited. No production security guarantee. Do not use real funds or real stablecoins.
The PQ gate is MockMLDSAVerifier — a MOCK. It performs structural length/shape checks only, NOT a real ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) cryptographic verification. See docs/Verifier_Roadmap.md.
MockUSDC (mUSDC), the token this simulator accepts, has no monetary value. There is no purchase path, no custody, and no income-generating product or promised returns.

All executable runtime bytecode, and all 8 EIP-712/immutable constructor values, were independently re-derived and matched the live Sepolia deployment exactly against public commit 35c25fa294bebea44b3089aa2435a190a5adf3fb (tag v0.4.24). Only the trailing 43-byte solc CBOR metadata hash — a non-executed IPFS content pointer, never run by the EVM — differs, consistent with a build-environment difference (OS/toolchain/path) rather than a source or code difference; it is not claimed to match and does not affect on-chain behavior.
Fee-on-transfer and rebasing tokens are explicitly unsupported by this simulator's accounting.
No Ethereum mainnet deployment of this contract exists or is planned.
